settings.header_sub: Five expertly curated collections. One goal — helping you move, recover and live without limits.
settings.col1_desc: Comfortable, wearable supports that gently realign the spine and shoulder girdle — helping you build lasting posture habits throughout the day.
settings.col2_desc: Sensor-driven wearables that monitor your posture in real time and give gentle, intelligent feedback — so your body learns without you thinking about it.
settings.col3_desc: Targeted rehab tools and training aids designed to strengthen the muscles that hold you upright — bridging the gap between injury and full recovery.
settings.col4_desc: Desks, cushions, supports and accessories designed around the human body — making every workspace a place your body actually thrives in.
settings.col5_desc: From TENS therapy devices and heated back wraps to lumbar compression belts — our most powerful collection for anyone dealing with persistent or acute back pain. Drug-free, clinically inspired and built to last.
